newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grain export commitments down on last year.
newsitem.headline: EU grain export commitments down on last year.

text.p: Latest European Union figures show grain export commitments between the start of the new season on July 1 and September 10 were 46 percent below year-ago levels, member country officials said on Monday.
The figures, based on delivered export certificates, showed grain sales plunged to 2.796 million tonnes from 5.213 million.
Commercial wheat exports fell to 713,000 tonnes from 2.305 million tonnes although heavy export commitments to China had driven up export figures at the start of the 1995/96 campaign.
Flour export commitments reached 945,000 tonnes against 1.194 million tonnes during the same period last year.
Commercial barley exports rose to 664,000 tonnes from 632,000 tonnes.
Since September 10, the EU has granted 27,300 tonnes of soft wheat, 423,185 tonnes of barley, 26,809 tonnes of rye and 5,100 tonnes of oats exports through its weekly grain tender system.
